implementationStatus: Proposed contract only. This file is neither a runnable layout nor a formal JSON Schema. Existing engine compatibility has not been verified.

packaging.catalog: catalog.json: explicit references to versioned definitions; no execution order inferred from directory names
packaging.identification: identification/<family>.json: composite fingerprints, independently scored category, producer and layout decisions
packaging.layouts: layouts/<layout>.json: nominal geometry, metadata, records, classification, groups and completeness
packaging.validation: validation/<layout>.json: scoped calculations and printed-control comparisons
packaging.models: models/<category>.json: semantic field names, types and mappings to C# domain models
packaging.schemas: schemas/*.schema.json: closed, operation-specific JSON Schemas to be supplied with the migrated definitions
packaging.bundle: Optional generated distribution bundle; separate files remain authoritative

loadChecks: Reject unknown operations, unknown executable properties and unsupported capabilities
Resolve every definition, variant, block, field, group, parser and rule reference
Reject duplicate IDs in their declared scope and cyclic calculation dependencies
Check rectangle ordering, positive dimensions and finite coordinates
Separate schema validity, evidence status and engine implementation status

scan.additionalPages: Conditional bounded scan of additional headers, bodies or last page/footer
scan.onBudgetExhausted: Return inspected coverage and unresolved decisions; never pretend full-document inspection

signal.evidenceGroup: Correlated signals share a score cap; repeated page headers cannot multiply confidence

decision.missingMarker: Neutral unless a particular rule explicitly establishes that it must be present
decision.producerGate: Generic title alone cannot confirm IfoSoft. A layout may require independent producer evidence before automatic selection.
decision.ties: Retain candidates and evidence; do not select the first definition

variant.selection: Use observed geometry and header differences; a shared GMX marker does not distinguish variants

field.locatorRequirements: Specify page scope, coordinate frame, region or anchor, text assembly and expected cardinality

rules: Keep licensed-user text separate from reporting entity
Never use a partner CIN as reporting-entity CIN
Keep printing date separate from fiscal year and transaction date
Metadata-only requests may inspect later pages when their locators require it
Missing metadata remains missing; filename-derived hints retain a separate origin

sourceConversion.gmxInterpretation: Sample-supported upper-left origin and tenths of millimeter; unrecognized flags remain opaque provenance

adapter.normalization: Explicitly account for PDF UserUnit, page rotation, crop-box origin and extractor-applied transforms; account for XPS/OXPS units, nested transforms and clipping
adapter.xpsPageOrder: Follow document/page package references, never ZIP entry order
adapter.sourceElements: Retain raw text, raw geometry, normalized geometry, glyph/cluster mapping, font information when available and clipping state
adapter.insufficientGlyphData: Return unsupportedCapability when safe field separation requires unavailable glyph geometry

calibration.constraints: Fit one positive uniform scale and independent translations per page from nondegenerate anchor correspondences; page dimensions alone cannot establish scale
calibration.anchorFeature: Specify matching feature: ruling endpoint, text baseline, text edge or other supported feature. Do not equate GMX rectangle corners with glyph bounds.
calibration.onFailure: Retain page and diagnostic; do not silently reuse another page's calibration

blocks.localOrigin: Nominal X=0 at detected block top; negative local Y extends downward
blocks.recordAdvance: Nominal advance is supporting evidence, not a formula that fabricates records
blocks.overlapPolicy: Allow declared field rectangles to overlap; preserve competing token assignments
blocks.fieldRegions: Soft search regions with explicit tolerances and assignment rules

geometry.candidateDetection: Union independent signals so malformed dates/accounts/amounts do not eliminate a candidate
geometry.output: Physical block occurrences, record candidates, field token assignments and unresolved/orphan tokens

parsing.decimal: Use decimal arithmetic and explicit formats per field/block. Distinct successful parse values remain ambiguous.
parsing.identifier: Keep leading zeros, letters, diacritics and allowed spaces
parsing.accountingPeriod: Preserve raw code and year separately. Observed 00 through 14 are not calendar months or a closed set; unknown codes are retained with a diagnostic.
parsing.blank: A scoped derivation may provide effective zero only for a confidently located blank monetary field; retain blank source state

classification.evaluate: Evaluate all rules; no match retains unrecognizedCandidate, incompatible matches retain ambiguity
classification.separation: Physical block kind is distinct from semantic class, export eligibility and each individual aggregation/count membership

completeness.selection: Required fields depend on semantic class, not every physical row
completeness.oneSidedJournal: Entry rules may require any of debitAccount/creditAccount; do not require both or invent pairs
completeness.unknownCandidate: Retain source occurrence and diagnostic; material unresolved candidates prevent clean success
completeness.coverage: Track document, group and page continuity. A header/footer-only page can be valid; contiguous available pages do not prove complete original input.

validation.scope: Explicit document/section/group occurrence and aggregation level
validation.count: Declare occurrence count or explicit distinct key; source numbered headings may count even when excluded from exported accounts
validation.sum: Select details or child summaries explicitly, never both accidentally
validation.missingInput: Inconclusive/notEvaluated with reason; do not default missing values to zero
validation.partialInput: Skip document-wide controls when required coverage is not established; evaluate eligible complete groups
validation.restriction: A matching total cannot resolve ambiguous parsing or prove extraction completeness

groupsContract.crossPage: Carry state only with recorded continuity evidence; repeated headers do not reset groups
groupsContract.trailingMetadata: A footer can supply group/document metadata to earlier members by explicit source references
groupsContract.conflicts: Never overwrite a conflicting explicit member value with inherited footer metadata
groupsContract.unclosedGroup: Retain group with incomplete coverage and diagnostics

executionContract.dependencies: Requested validation promotes effective extraction level; return requested and effective levels
executionContract.caching: Reuse decoded pages within a request and compiled immutable definitions by version/hash
executionContract.domainModels: AJ/AF/GL mappings are separate from the positioned-document engine; future invoice and bank-statement models use the same contracts where applicable
executionContract.extensionBoundary: New layouts need JSON only when existing bounded operations and adapters express them; genuinely new behavior requires an explicit versioned engine capability
executionContract.onLimit: Return incomplete result with diagnostic and retained evidence

provenanceContract.identity: Use source occurrence identity; duplicate business identifiers do not imply duplicate records

testManifestContract.accountingEntity: Split initial eight-digit CIN and name at first ' - '; retain original value and leading zeros
testManifestContract.expectedYear: Four-digit year or blank when no expectation is asserted
testManifestContract.confirmedCorrections: Rows 101 and 106 of the supplied second CSV both have expected year 2025 per user confirmation
testManifestContract.expectations: Compare only after independent processing; never feed expected year/entity/category or historical outcome into detection
testManifestContract.paths: Absolute paths supported; relative paths resolved against manifest directory
testManifestContract.formats: Allow PDF/XPS/OXPS filtering; explicitly report excluded or unsupported inputs

output.csv: One row per manifest row with expected/actual metadata, recognition, processing, expectation comparison, coverage, record count, validation summary, standard category totals and explanations
output.json: Full results including multiple scopes/periods, named totals, calculated/printed values, differences and evidence
output.statuses: Keep processing, recognition, expectation comparison and validation statuses separate

migrationDecisions: Preserve existing converted GMX geometry and source provenance; do not reconvert point coordinates
Replace prose-only executable instructions with operation-specific typed arguments in step 2
Split category/producer/layout recognition and add concrete metadata locators
Move required-field decisions from raw geometry to class-dependent completeness rules
Give every calculation an explicit scope and member selection
Replace empirical UCT_ROZVRH geometry using sample-matching _UROZVRH.gmx; _UROZVRH_V2.gmx remains a separate unverified variant
Retain DENNIK1 header variants despite identical record geometry
Classify PREDVAS3 as GL; preserve uncertainty for account-movement category mappings
Keep unverified controls disabled until semantics and matching samples establish their meaning
reviewGate: Review this structure before migrating all definitions. Step 2 supplies formal JSON Schemas, typed operation arguments, migrated definitions and reference-validation results. Production code is unchanged.
